statement: Every HodgeComputer.Verify F A F.totalDegree q D N Q for the exact protected symmetric-sextic-residual target has 4 <= D.totalDegree. Q is unrestricted; legality, homogeneous projection, and Euler normalization are used explicitly.
generic_scope: All characteristic-zero fields, all homogeneous denominator degrees d <= 3, integral g_i congruent to 2 Z_i^5 modulo 5. The normalized first equation forces N=D=0.
method: Uniform selected coefficient minor; its reduction is diagonal with entries 2 and -1. No concrete large matrix computation or external oracle is used by Lean.
limitations: This gives a denominator-degree lower bound; it does not rule out larger denominators or construct a certificate.
